```{r}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
set.seed(1)
all_ge = open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")
genes_to_remove <- rownames(all_ge)[grepl("^Gm|Rik", rownames(all_ge))]

animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
#load animal phenotype data
animal_phenotype_data = read.csv("../shared objs and code/YM_CFC_BW_SM_calo_AB_individual_data_cleaned_20240826.csv")
animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice = animal_phenotype_data %>% filter(ID %in% animal_metadata$animal_id)
#add age of death, then filter behavioral metadata for this timepoint, since some mice were phenotyped more than just prior to death. But our analysis will focus on the data collected from the timepoint prior to death. 

animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$age_at_death = animal_metadata$age[match(animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$ID, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
animal_phenotype_data_at_death = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>% filter(age_at_death == AgeGrp)


#add CFA and CFM (cognitive metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$CFA = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFC.PS4[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
animal_metadata$CFM = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFM.Total[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]


#add Weight (metabolic/physical metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$Weight = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$Weight[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
#z score continuous variables (Weight, CFA, CFM)
animal_metadata <- animal_metadata %>%
  mutate(across(c(Weight, CFA, CFM), ~ scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]))

#change age_at_death to "young" for 6 and "old" for 14
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "6" ~ "young",
  animal_metadata$age == "14" ~ "old",
  .default = NA
)

#load neuronal + non-neuronal assignments
non_neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
cluster_assignments = non_neuronal_cluster_assignments

#create df with cell id and cluster for each cell
cell_metadata = data.frame(cell_id = names(cluster_assignments), cluster = cluster_assignments)
#get animal id from name of cell ()
cell_metadata$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", cell_metadata$cell_id)
#join cell metadata with animal metadata by animal_id
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")

# Split  on cell class
cell_metadata$cell_class <- sub("[-_].*", "", cell_metadata$cluster)
```

Cluster marker dotplots 
```{r}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
# ── Helper function ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Builds a dot-plot dataframe and returns a ggplot object for one cell class.
#
# Arguments:
#   cell_metadata  – data.frame with columns cell_id, cluster, cell_class, …
#   all_ge         – BPCells matrix (genes × cells)
#   class_name     – character, value in cell_metadata$cell_class to subset
#   selected_genes – character vector of genes to plot (x-axis order)
#   cluster_rename – named character vector  old_name = "new label"
#   plot_title     – plot title string
#   y_label        – y-axis label string

create_marker_dotplot <- function(cell_metadata, all_ge,
                                  class_name,
                                  selected_genes,
                                  cluster_rename,
                                  plot_title,
                                  y_label) {

  # Subset to cell class

  cur_meta <- cell_metadata %>% filter(cell_class == class_name)
  cur_ge   <- all_ge[, cur_meta$cell_id]

  # Normalize + log-transform
  cur_ge_ln <- multiply_cols(cur_ge, 1 / Matrix::colSums(cur_ge))
  cur_ge_ln <- log1p(cur_ge_ln * 1e6)

  # Percent expressed (per cluster)
  percent_pb <- (cur_ge[selected_genes,] > 0) %>%
    pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = cur_meta$cluster, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

  # Mean log-normalised expression (per cluster)
  ln_pb <- cur_ge_ln[selected_genes, ] %>%
    pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = cur_meta$cluster, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

  # Assemble long-form data frame
  dotplot_df <- data.frame()
  for (gene in selected_genes) {
    for (cluster in unique(cur_meta$cluster)) {
      avg_exp <- ln_pb[gene, cluster]
      pct_exp <- percent_pb[gene, cluster] * 100
      dotplot_df <- rbind(dotplot_df,
                          data.frame(gene = gene, cluster = cluster,
                                     avg_exp = avg_exp, pct_exp = pct_exp))
    }
  }

  # Gene factor levels → controls x-axis order
  dotplot_df$gene <- factor(dotplot_df$gene, levels = selected_genes)

  # Z-score expression per gene
  dotplot_df <- dotplot_df %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    mutate(avg_exp = scale(avg_exp)[, 1]) %>%
    ungroup()

  dotplot_df$cluster <- str_to_title(dotplot_df$cluster)
  
  if (!is.null(cluster_rename)) {
    idx <- match(dotplot_df$cluster, names(cluster_rename))
    dotplot_df$cluster[!is.na(idx)] <- cluster_rename[idx[!is.na(idx)]]
  }  
  dotplot_df$cluster <- str_wrap(dotplot_df$cluster, width = 20) %>%str_replace_all("\n", "<br>")
  # Build ggplot
  p <- ggplot(dotplot_df,
              aes(x = gene, y = cluster, fill = avg_exp, size = pct_exp)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black") +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 15, name = "Percent\nExpressed") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(mid = "white", high = "#D55E00", low = "#0072B2",
                         name = "Scaled\nExpression") +
    ggtitle(plot_title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 30, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(face = "bold.italic",size = 17),
      axis.text.y  = element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 17),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.5, "cm")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Gene", y = y_label)
  return(p)
}

vlmc_genes = c("Adamtsl3","Slc4a10","Col15a1","Cecr2", "Rad51b", "Abca8a","Lepr", "Slc13a4","Slc7a14", "Cubn","Slc47a1","Col1a1","Dpp4","Ppp1r1a","Slc7a11","Lama1","Col15a1","Tcf21")%>% unique

ependymal_genes <-
  c("Gria1","Dgkb","Col6a5","Mtus2","Tsc22d1","Sulf1") %>% rev()

tanycyte_genes = c("P3h2", "Ephb1","Col25a1", "Fndc3c1","Rspo3","Luzp2",
  "Cd59a", "Slc17a8", "Crym","Frzb", "Penk","Cacna2d2",  "Adm",
  "Col23a1", "Slc16a2", "Rax", "Lhx2", "Prdx6")

vascular_genes = c("Pecam1", "Cdh5", "Cd34","Tmsb10", "Ctla2a", "Gkn3", "Mgp", "Sema3g", "Stmn2","Plvap", "Col15a1", "Exoc3l2", "Emcn", "Flt1", "Ctss","Kcnj8","Rgs5", "Myh11","Acta2","Cav1")

vlmc_rename <- c(
  "Vlmc-1" = "VLMC-1 (*Adamtsl3*/*Slc4a10* Dural Border Cells)",
  "Vlmc-2" = "VLMC-2 (*Col15a1*/*Cecr2*)",
  "Vlmc-3" = "VLMC-3 (*Rad51b*/*Abca8a*)",
  "Vlmc-4" = "VLMC-4 (*Lepr*/*Slc13a4*)",
  "Vlmc-5" = "VLMC-5 (*Slc7a14*/*Cubn* Arachnoid Barrier Cells)"
)

vlmc_plot <- create_marker_dotplot(
  cell_metadata  = cell_metadata,
  all_ge         = all_ge,
  class_name     = "VLMC",
  selected_genes = vlmc_genes,
  cluster_rename = vlmc_rename,
  plot_title     = "VLMC Cluster Markers",
  y_label        = "VLMC Cluster"
)

ependymal_rename <- c(
  "Ependymal-1" = "Ependymal-1 (*Sulf1*/*Tsc22d1*)",  
  "Ependymal-2" = "Ependymal-2 (*Mtus2*/*Col6a5*)",      
  "Ependymal-3" = "Ependymal-3 (*Dgkb*/*Gria1*)"  
)


ependymal_plot <- create_marker_dotplot(
  cell_metadata  = cell_metadata,
  all_ge         = all_ge,
  class_name     = "ependymal",
  selected_genes = ependymal_genes,
  cluster_rename = ependymal_rename,
  plot_title     = "Ependymal Marker Gene Expression",
  y_label        = "Ependymal Cluster"
)


tanycyte_rename <- c(
  "Tanycyte-1" = "Tanycyte-1 (*P3h2*/*Ephb1*)",
  "Tanycyte-2" = "Tanycyte-2 (*Col25a1*/*Fndc3c1* Beta-2 Tanycytes)",
  "Tanycyte-3" = "Tanycyte-3 (*Rspo3*/*Luzp2*)"
)


tanycyte_plot <- create_marker_dotplot(
  cell_metadata  = cell_metadata,
  all_ge         = all_ge,
  class_name     = "tanycyte",
  selected_genes = tanycyte_genes,
  cluster_rename = tanycyte_rename,
  plot_title     = "Tanycyte Cluster Markers",
  y_label        = "Tanycyte Cluster")



vascular_rename <- c(
  "Vascular-Endothelial_1" = "Endothelial-1 (*Cav1*/*Ctla2a* Arteries)", 
  "Vascular-Endothelial_2" = "Endothelial-2 (*Gkn3* Veins)",
  "Vascular-Endothelial_3" = "Endothelial-3 (*Plvap*/*Col15a1*/*Exoc3l2* Fenestrated)",
  "Vascular-Pericytes"     = "Pericytes (*Rgs5*/*Kcnj8*)",
  "Vascular-Smc"           = "SMC (*Myh11*/*Acta2*)"
)

vascular_plot <- create_marker_dotplot(
  cell_metadata  = cell_metadata,
  all_ge         = all_ge,
  class_name     = "vascular",
  selected_genes = vascular_genes,
  cluster_rename = vascular_rename,
  plot_title     = "Vascular Marker Gene Expression",
  y_label        = "Vascular Cluster"
)

###############################################################################
# Composite Figure (Panels A–D)
###############################################################################
library(patchwork)

composite <- (vlmc_plot / ependymal_plot / tanycyte_plot / vascular_plot) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40))

ggsave("non_neuronal_marker_dotplots_composite.pdf",
       composite, width = 18, height = 25)
```
